selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the 271 absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. No word article is added: 23 existing articles each gain one link to a new card. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside. The rows 皇 (731) and 眼 (746) fall among the 11 rows whose declaring articles (天皇, 眼鏡) use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings and are not selected. One card also changes in one remark: the 潔 card's remark that said 癖 in 潔癖 had no card here now links 癖. 121 rows of the 271 group, 11 rows whose declaring articles use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings, and 644 rows with no declaring article remain.

Some readings on the cards rest on a single dictionary entry or a Kanjipedia-only entry and are labelled as source-only where they appear; the card text is the authority for which.
